question: Who can determine auspicious or inauspicious outcomes in that very terrible time?
premises: The time in question is described as very terrible.
Auspicious and inauspicious outcomes are considered.
The verse questions who can go to or determine them.
inference: In such a terrible time, no one can reliably determine auspicious or inauspicious outcomes.
uncertainties: The exact force of gacchati in this context may imply attainment or discernment.
plain_english: And in that very terrible time, who can determine what is auspicious or inauspicious?
